يستغفلوا (form X)
# يَسْتَغْفِلُوا (yastaḡfilū) /jas.taɣ.fi.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغْفَلَ (istaḡfala)
# يُسْتَغْفَلُوا (yustaḡfalū) /jus.taɣ.fa.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغْفَلَ (istaḡfala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
